name: stri_count_boundaries
title: Count the Number of Text Boundaries

origin.description: Count character, word, line, or sentence boundaries in each string.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, or an object coerced to character.

arguments.name: opts_brkiter
arguments.text: Break-iterator settings. NULL uses the line breaker.
Further settings passed to stri_opts_brkiter, including type, locale, and skip_*.

origin.details: Vectorized over str. The default iterator is line_break. type is character, line_break, sentence, word, or a unique prefix of one of those. A skip_* flag drops every segment whose ending boundary has that ICU rule status. The skipped text is not joined to the next segment. An omitted skip acts as FALSE. A missing string is NA. An empty string counts as 0.
origin.value: An integer vector the same length as str.
origin.example:
x <- stri_count_boundaries("A\u0301", type = "character")
cat(paste0('stri_count_boundaries("A\u0301", type = "character") returns ', x, '.\n'))

translation.description: Count character, word, line, or sentence boundaries in each string.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, or a list of those. None is an empty vector.

arguments.name: opts_brkiter
arguments.text: A dict of supplied break-iterator settings. None uses the line breaker.

arguments.name: kwargs
arguments.text: Further settings passed to stri_opts_brkiter. A repeated name is an error.

translation.details: The default iterator is line_break. BreakIterator indexes are UTF-16 code units and are converted to code points. type is character, line_break, sentence, word, or a unique prefix. A skip_* flag drops every segment whose ending boundary has that rule status. An omitted skip is false. NA stays missing. The string "NA" is text. An empty string counts as 0.
translation.value: A list of ints. A missing result is NA. None returns an empty list.
translation.example:
from stringi.boundary import stri_count_boundaries
x = stri_count_boundaries("A\u0301", type="character")
print(f'stri_count_boundaries("A\u0301", type="character") returns {x[0]}.')
